### Notes

The program is described only from the partner side: Close is recruiting accelerators/incubators to carry the deal, so a founder reaches it through their own accelerator's perks marketplace rather than by applying to Close directly. What I could NOT inspect: the actual discount percentage, duration, and any startup eligibility criteria are not published on any Close page — the partner page states the deal exists but names no figure. Separately, https://close.com/crm-for-startups is purely marketing and contains no startup discount; it offers only the standard "Try Close free for 14 days. No credit card required" trial available to everyone. Close also runs an unrelated Visa Small Business offer (20% off the first month) which is not a startup program. accelerator_required is left unknown because the page states the distribution channel without stating it is the only route. Imported from a verification sweep whose quote fidelity later failed audit in 13 of 22 sampled records.
